mapper.sql: select c.conversation_id, c.knowledge_base_id, k.knowledge_base_name, k.brand_id, b.brand_name, k.model_id, m.model_name, c.user_id, c.title, c.status, c.last_message_time, c.del_flag, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time from oc_ai_conversation c inner join oc_knowledge_base k on k.knowledge_base_id = c.knowledge_base_id left join oc_brand b on b.brand_id = k.brand_id left join oc_product_model m on m.model_id = k.model_id
mapper.select: where c.user_id = #{userId} and c.status = '0' and c.del_flag = '0' order by coalesce(c.last_message_time, c.create_time) desc, c.conversation_id desc limit 100
mapper.insert: insert into oc_ai_conversation ( knowledge_base_id, user_id, title, status, last_message_time, del_flag, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{knowledgeBaseId}, #{userId}, #{title}, '0', null, '0', #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update oc_ai_conversation set title = #{title}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
update oc_ai_conversation set del_flag = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
